comments.author: Jafar
comments.body:
10m at most for the jewellery you can buy from NPCs along the African coast, Persian gulf, and some of the more common shipwreck jewellery.

This one isn't common, the only way to get it is as a memorial album award. Couple that with the high demand of wares trading to craft almost anything, and the fact that this brooch has no effect to prevent dura loss, and yes, it costs more.

comments.author: Laurencio
comments.body: but it's an easy memorial album to do, which means lots of players, in fact, do it. Also, unlike the jewelry you can buy here there and everywhere, this degrades. 40m's nuts, you can buy two jade necklaces for that much anymore

comments.author: Sonia
comments.body:
1. It's the ONLY ITEM with +2 wares trading.
2. That it loses dura just makes it more uncommon.
3. Jade necks have been free in 2 events, in at least one TB, are freely available from barmaids now, and have an effect (no dura loss). It's not surprising that there is more supply than demand.

There is just no motivation to sell this item cheaply. Why would you? Most people grind at least one production skill, and aside from cooking, wares can help all of them. You know the thing is gonna wear out eventually, assuming you produce at sea, so why would you throw it away for cheap?
